## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this 

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

```{r}
breeding_site_selected <- breeding_site |> select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) 
gt(breeding_site_selected)
```
```{r}
breeding_site_selected <- breeding_site |> select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |> distinct()
gt(breeding_site_selected)
```
```{r}
breeding_site_selected <- breeding_site |>
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(Breeding_Longitude = Longitude, Breeding_Latitude = Latitude)

gt(breeding_site_selected)
```
```{r}
migratory_yay_selected <- migratory_yay|> select( Site, winterLongitude, winterLatitude, pslon, pslat, iblon, iblat, awestlon, awestlat)|>distinct()|> rename(Winter_Longitude = winterLongitude, Winter_Latitude = winterLatitude, Stopover_Longitude = pslon, Stopover_Latitude = pslat, Iberian_Longitude = iblon, Iberian_Latitude = iblat, Westmost_Longitude = awestlon, Westmost_Latitude = awestlat )
gt(migratory_yay_selected)
```
```{r}
breeding_dartmoor <- breeding_site_selected |> filter(Site=="Dartmoor")
gt(breeding_dartmoor)
```
```{r}
bird_breeding_exc <- breeding_site_selected |> filter(Site != "Spain")
bird_migration_exc <- migratory_yay_selected |> filter(Site !="Spain")
gt(bird_breeding_exc)
gt(bird_migration_exc)
```
```{r}
bird_migration_grouped <- bird_migration_exc |> group_by(Site)
glimpse(bird_migration_grouped)
```
```{r}lat_df <- bird_migration_grouped|> summarise(Highest_Lat_Stopover = max(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE))
gt(lat_df)
```
```{r}
lat_df <- bird_migration_grouped|> summarise(Highest_Lat_Stopover = max(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE))
gt(lat_df)
```
```{r}
bird_migration_grouped <- bird_migration_exc |> group_by(Site)

bird_migration_summary <- bird_migration_grouped |>
  summarise(
    Stopover_Longitude = median(Stopover_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Stopover_Latitude = median(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Iberian_Longitude = median(Iberian_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Iberian_Latitude = median(Iberian_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Westmost_Longitude = median(Westmost_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Westmost_Latitude = median(Westmost_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Winter_Longitude = median(Winter_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Winter_Latitude = median(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
gt(bird_migration_summary)
```
```{r}
combined_bird_data <- full_join(bird_breeding_exc, bird_migration_summary) 
gt(combined_bird_data)
```
```{r}
combined_bird_piv <- combined_bird_data |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with(c("_Longitude", "_Latitude")),
    names_sep = "_",
    names_to = c("Location_Type", ".value")
  )

gt(combined_bird_piv)
```
```{r}
spring_vals <- c("Breeding", "Stopover", "Winter")
autumn_vals <- c("Breeding", "Iberian", "Westmost", "Winter")

Spring_data <- combined_bird_piv |> filter(Location_Type %in% spring_vals)
autumn_data <- combined_bird_piv |> filter(Location_Type %in% autumn_vals)
```
```{r}
write_csv(Spring_data, "output/birds_spring.csv")
write_csv(autumn_data, "output/birds_autumn.csv")
```
```{r}
gt(Spring_data)
ggplot(Spring_data)
ggplot(Spring_data, aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude))
ggplot(Spring_data, aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude)) + geom_point()
ggplot(
  Spring_data,
  aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude)
) +
  geom_point() +
  annotation_borders(linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_quickmap()
```
```{r}
min_lon <- Spring_data |> pull(Longitude)|> min()
print(min_lon)
max_lon <- Spring_data |> pull(Longitude)|> max()
print(max_lon) 
min_lat <- Spring_data |> pull(Latitude)|> min()
print(min_lat)
max_lat <- Spring_data |> pull(Latitude)|> max()
print(max_lat)
```
```{r}
ggplot(
  Spring_data,
  aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude)
) +
  geom_point() +
  annotation_borders(linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_quickmap(xlim = c(min_lon - 2, max_lon + 2))
```
```{r}
ggplot(
  Spring_data,
  aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, shape= Location_Type, color = Site)
) +
  geom_point(size=3) +
  annotation_borders(linewidth = 0.2) + coord_quickmap(xlim=c(min_lon -2, max_lon +2), ylim = c(min_lat -2, max_lat +2)) + geom_path(aes(group= Site)) + ggtitle("Pied Flycatcher Spring Migration Routes") +
  xlab("Longitude (°)") +
  ylab("Latitude (°)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
